name: Navigation bar
summary: 移动端顶层目的地导航，使用图标、选中指示器和文字标签帮助定位。
behavior: 提供 3-5 个同级目的地
切换目的地不应丢失导航上下文
accessibility: 每个目的地有可访问名称
选中态通过语义和视觉双重表达
do: 让当前目的地清楚可见
dont: 不要用纯图标隐藏目的地含义

en.summary: Mobile top-level destination navigation that uses icons, an active indicator, and text labels to preserve orientation.
behavior: Provide three to five peer destinations
Preserve navigation context when changing destinations
accessibility: Give every destination an accessible name
Express the selected state both semantically and visually
do: Make the current destination clearly visible
dont: Do not place one-off actions in the navigation bar
Do not hide destination meaning behind icons alone
